title: Late returns
statementMd:
Count loans returned after their due date.

Expected columns: `late_returns`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS late_returns FROM loans WHERE return_date > due_date;
```
